notes.title: Glass Masquerade 4: Constellations - Anounce!
notes.content:
[p]Many of you have been asking for more stained glass puzzles - and here they are, coming in a few weeks or less. As always, thank you so much for your support over the years and the warm feedback that keeps this series going!

Based on your feedback on the last game in this series, we decided to return to the classic Tiffany-style stained glass and assembling the pieces along the glass lines. However, you will still be able to play with the board cut layouts that were introduced in the third part of the series.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3845830/Glass_Masquerade_4_Constellations/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.4.3
notes.content:
Here is a cumulative list of changes which were introduced during the last months, and today partly:
[list]
    [*]Puzzle wheels now can be scrolled by Mouse Wheel, or by Right Mouse Button exclusively (ported from Glass Masquerade 2)
    [*]Released Halloween & Inceptions DLC's
    [*]The game was ported to Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, PlayStation 4 and Android. Console ports were provided and published by Digerati Distributions / Stage Clear Studios
    [*]Added Polish language localization (by Agnieszka Kołodziej)
    [*]Now you can use Steam launch option "-show-screen-selector" to be able to adjust screen resolution / fullscreen before the game runs - it allows to resolve some issues when the game fails to run after game engine's major update in 2018
    [*]Slightly improved performance for low-end PC's
    [*]Made a workaround when achievements sometimes were not granted for starting or finishing the game - now you just can enter the game and everything will be automatically granted corresponding to your progress.
    [*]Fixed a rare issue when save files become corrupted (was reported just once, but become more frequent in Glass Masquerade 2)
[/list]

notes.title: Announce: Glass Masquerade 2: Illusions
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26876365/7d5a08a5130feba6976e36e1460436c805f466d5.png[/img]

Many of you asked us for a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/511470/]Glass Masquerade[/url] sequel and here it is!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/935880/Glass_Masquerade_2_Illusions/

Despite the gameplay and screens on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/935880/Glass_Masquerade_2_Illusions/]store page[/url] feels raw and still far from what we are targeting for, we'd like to share with you what we came with for now and hope you will like our new direction for the title. With your great support, we already finished all puzzle arts and now are busy with creating a new game map, graphics style & UI. 

Don't forget to subscribe for official [url=store.steampowered.com/developer/onyxlute]Onyx Lute[/url] developer page to be noticed by Steam when our titles get released alongside with new DLCs. We have much more content for you coming in 2019!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
- Glass Masquerade is now supporting alternate [b]"Click, then Drag"[/b] input mode, so there is no need to hold the mouse button for a long time anymore.
- Fixed critical visual issues on super-widescreen monitors (21:9 and others), and pink/white screen edges on some widescreen monitors (16:9).
- Fixed an issue when the game didn't properly start on some Macs.
- Game settings were moved to the external file and can be manually edited before the game starts.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
- [b][i]Trading cards[/i][/b] for [i]Glass Masquerade[/i] are now collectible!
- Added proper support for all resolutions with non-widescreen aspect ratios (instead of back bars, which were used before)
- Fixed several bugs with UI being incorrectly displayed on some computers
- Added possibility to completely reset game progress using secret key combination: [code]LShift + RShift + W[/code]
